set.body:
Goal: discrete position scales that map categorical levels to band positions/widths, so bars and boxplots can sit at named x positions. Positions are bare Double today.

Evidence: position mapping assumes continuous rescale into [0,1] (Scales.scala:468-475); DiscreteScale exists (Scales.scala:558-587) but only for non-position aesthetics (color/fill/shape). No band scale, no per-band width.

Acceptance: a band position scale (levels -> center + width, configurable padding) usable on x/y; the derived axis places one tick per band at its center; interacts correctly with stat_count and with dodge/stack position adjustments; conformance gains a bar-by-condition case; parity note against ggplot2 discrete positions; JVM+JS tests.
set.title: Graphics: discrete/band position scales (bars, boxplots by condition)
